snippet.title: Everwind - The First Ascent Update Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Everwind's ""The First Ascent"" Update: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253100 

Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world. The First Ascent Update marks Everwind’s first major post–Early Access update, introducing new challenges, enemies, customization options, and powerful gear inspired by community feedback.  ""The First Ascent"" update is coming out in May 2026.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
